subject: english
stem: The next message is for students and families. Which detail is stated in the message?
options: the silver bottle claim has no test method or source
the silver bottle claim names one test method but no source
the black bottle claim has no test method or source
the silver bottle claim has a source but no test conditions

optionRationales.reason: the silver bottle claim has no test method or source：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。音稿明確陳述「the silver bottle claim has no test method or source」。

the silver bottle claim names one test method but no source：此項把「has no test method or」改成「names one test method but no」。音稿明確陳述「the silver bottle claim has no test method or source」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the silver bottle claim has no test method or source」。
the black bottle claim has no test method or source：此項把「silver」改成「black」。音稿明確陳述「the silver bottle claim has no test method or source」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the silver bottle claim has no test method or source」。

the silver bottle claim has a source but no test conditions：此項把「no test method or source」改成「a source but no test conditions」。音稿明確陳述「the silver bottle claim has no test method or source」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the silver bottle claim has no test method or source」。
